bib.title: VL-BERT: Pre-training of Generic Visual-Linguistic Representations

question: Can one single-stream Transformer over words and image RoIs, pre-trained generically, serve many visual-linguistic tasks without task-specific modules?
hypothesis: A unified single-stream model with early free interaction between visual and linguistic elements, pre-trained on captions plus text-only data, outperforms task-specific and two-stream designs.
contributions: VL-BERT: BERT backbone taking words and RoIs as input with a new visual feature embedding
Pre-training on Conceptual Captions plus text-only corpora with masked language modeling with visual clues and masked RoI classification with linguistic clues
No sentence-image relationship task; Fast R-CNN is tuned end to end with pixel-level RoI masking
State of the art on VCR (first single model on leaderboard), competitive on VQA and RefCOCO+

method.summary: BERT is extended with RoI tokens (Fast R-CNN appearance feature plus box geometry embedding), initialised from BERT, and pre-trained jointly on Conceptual Captions and BooksCorpus/Wikipedia, then fine-tuned end to end on VCR, VQA v2.0 and RefCOCO+.
method.task: visual-linguistic pre-training; VCR, VQA, referring expression comprehension

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions
datasets.preprocessing: Pre-trained Faster R-CNN extracts RoIs: at most 100 with score above 0.5, at least 10 regardless of threshold

datasets.name: BooksCorpus + English Wikipedia
datasets.split: 1:1 sampling ratio against Conceptual Captions per mini-batch
datasets.source: Zhu et al., 2015; as used for BERT

datasets.name: VCR
datasets.size: 265k question/answer/rationale pairs over 100k unique movie scenes

datasets.name: VQA v2.0
datasets.split: train 83k images 444k questions; val 41k images 214k questions; test 81k images 448k questions
datasets.preprocessing: 3,129-answer shared set; RoIs from Visual Genome-pretrained Faster R-CNN (BUTD)

datasets.name: RefCOCO+
datasets.size: 141k expressions for 50k objects in 20k COCO images
datasets.preprocessing: ground-truth RoIs or MAttNet detected boxes

models.name: VL-BERT_BASE
models.init_from: BERT_BASE; new parameters ~ Gaussian mean 0 std 0.02; Faster R-CNN + ResNet-101 initialised from Visual Genome detection weights (BUTD)

training.objective: Pre-training: masked LM with visual clues (15% word masking) + masked RoI classification with linguistic clues (15% RoI masking, pixels zeroed, label from pre-trained detector) + standard MLM on text-only data. Fine-tuning: VCR answer-correctness softmax + RoI classification; VQA multi-class cross-entropy over answers from [MASK] output; RefCOCO+ per-RoI binary classification.
training.optimizer: Pre-training: Adam (b1=0.9, b2=0.999). Fine-tuning: VCR SGD with momentum 0.9; VQA and RefCOCO+ Adam (b1=0.9, b2=0.999)
training.lr_schedule: pre-training, VQA, RefCOCO+: linear decay after warmup; VCR: decayed by 0.1 at epochs 14 and 18
training.warmup: pre-training 8,000 steps; VCR 1,000 steps from 0; VQA 2,000; RefCOCO+ 500
training.batch_size: pre-training 256 (128 Conceptual Captions pairs + 128 text sequences); fine-tuning 256 per task
training.hardware: 16 Tesla V100 GPUs (pre-training and each fine-tuning)

other.fast_rcnn: parameters tuned in both pre-training and fine-tuning
other.whole_image_box: a box covering whole image added as an RoI and never masked

inference.decoding: VQA: argmax over 3,129 answers; RefCOCO+: RoI with highest classification score; VCR: pick answer with highest correctness score (inferred from per-answer classifier)
inference.samples: single run; no seeds or error bars reported

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: VCR Q->A, QA->R, Q->AR (both correct); VQA v2.0 test-dev/test-std; RefCOCO+ val/testA/testB on ground-truth or detected regions

eval.protocol: Single model; VCR follows R2C protocol, VQA follows BUTD; ablation on val/test-dev with 0.5x fine-tuning epochs.

evidence.quote: In SGD, the basic mini-batch gradient descent is conducted, with base learning rate of 5 × 10−3, momentum of 0.9

limits: Layer count, hidden size, heads and parameter count are not stated; they come from BERT_BASE/LARGE by reference.
No seeds, runs or error bars; ablation gaps are 1.2 points or less.
Ablation uses half the fine-tuning epochs and BASE only; the matching-loss explanation is a guess.
Text claims the text-only corpus helps all three tasks, but Table 4 shows VQA and RefCOCO+ unchanged.
Concurrent with ViLBERT, LXMERT, VisualBERT; no comparison to later models such as UNITER.
Lags LXMERT on VQA; authors say LXMERT pre-trains on VQA data.
Future work: better pre-training tasks, image caption generation.

terms.term: Masked RoI Classification with Linguistic Clues
terms.definition: Each RoI is masked with 15% probability (pixels set to zero) and the model predicts its category label from the other clues

lineage.note: Two-stream claimed superior; VL-BERT says unified model outperforms and matching task does not help
lineage.quote: We found that our uniﬁed model of VL-BERT outperforms such two-stream designs.

figures.caption: Architecture for pre-training VL-BERT. All the parameters in this architecture including VL-BERT and Fast R-CNN are jointly trained in both pre-training and ﬁne-tuning phases.
figures.why: Shows the four summed embeddings and both masking tasks
